defects.description: The decline is stated as 'more than 2.5 billion fewer', but the excerpt's own figures give 2.3 billion (1990) minus about 800 million (2025), i.e. roughly 1.5 billion fewer.
paraphrases: 2.3 billion in 1990 minus ~800 million in 2025 is about 1.5 billion, not 2.5 billion.
The stated size of the decline in extreme poverty contradicts the two counts given in the same passage.
The '2.5 billion fewer' figure is arithmetically wrong; it should be about 1.5 billion.
defects.rationale: Correct value ~1.5 billion (2.3B - 0.8B), stated in OWID as 'more than 1.5 billion'. Findable from the two counts in the same passage, distinct.

defects.description: The text says two-thirds (66%) live on less than $5 a day while only half (52%) live on less than $10 a day, which is impossible: everyone below $5 is also below $10, so the $10 share cannot be smaller than the $5 share.
paraphrases: The share under $5/day (66%) exceeds the share under $10/day (52%), but a lower threshold must capture no more people than a higher one.
It is contradictory for more of the world to live under $5 than under $10, since the under-$5 group is a subset of the under-$10 group.
The $5-a-day percentage is larger than the $10-a-day percentage, which cannot hold for nested poverty lines (the real value is 24%).
defects.rationale: Correct value 24% (< 52%). Findable from the nesting of the two thresholds stated in the same paragraph, distinct.

defects.description: The extreme-poverty threshold is given inconsistently: 'less than $2 a day' in one sentence but the 'International Poverty Line of $3 per day' in the next.
paraphrases: The passage names the poverty line as both $2 a day and $3 per day.
Two different dollar figures ($2 vs $3) are used for the same extreme-poverty line within a few lines.
The '$2 a day' threshold contradicts the '$3 per day' International Poverty Line stated just after it.
defects.rationale: Correct value '$3 a day' (matching the International Poverty Line stated on the next line). Findable within the passage, distinct from the other defects.
